bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: You used to charge $3,000 for this framework. Today it's $69.99 a month.
beats.text: Your Elite Access page says it's “the same framework I once charged $3,000 for — at a fraction of the cost.” That keeps the community full, but it leaves nothing for the traders who want more than a trade room: your time, one-on-one.

stats.label: what the framework used to cost

beats.title: 921 people in your free community. 84 pay.
beats.text: Zen Lab has 1,250 members on Whop and 2,550 on Discord, and your free 5-hour course on YouTube teaches the whole system. Plenty of those people already trust how you trade. A mentorship gives the serious ones a reason to talk to you.

beats.title: The only step after free is a $69.99 button.
beats.text: Your Linktree leads with the free community and the free course. From there, the only paid step is the Elite Access checkout. Anyone ready to pay for real help never gets asked what they need.

beats.title: “I dropped the price on purpose.” It stays.
beats.text: Elite Access stays at $69.99 and keeps the community growing. The mentorship sits on top: one page, a short application, and a call, only for the members who want you one-on-one. Your low-ticket offer becomes the way in, not the ceiling.
beats.quote: “After 10+ years of trading the markets, I built Zen Lab to help traders learn through real market experience.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.body: You've watched the course. You still can't tell why your trades go wrong when his go right.

cards.title: You trade too much
cards.body: Two clean setups a day turn into six forced ones. Nobody stops you.

cards.title: You switch systems
cards.body: A bad week and you're on to the next strategy, so you never master one.

mechanism.title: One system, mastered
mechanism.body: Simplicity wins. You trade one mechanical system during the high-volume sessions, follow fixed risk-to-reward and stop rules, and journal every trade. In the mentorship, Emmitt reviews your trades with you until the system is yours.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and what keeps going wrong.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Emmitt

preCallEmails.subject: Why simplicity wins
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders don't fail because their strategy is bad. They fail because they switch strategies every time they lose.

The mentorship is built on one mechanical system, traded only in the high-volume sessions, with fixed risk on every trade.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Emmitt

preCallEmails.subject: "I'm already in Elite Access"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Good. Then you know the system and the trade rooms.

The mentorship is for when watching isn't enough anymore: one-on-one reviews of your own trades and your journal, so you see exactly where you break the rules.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Emmitt

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Emmitt

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Emmitt's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Emmitt

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Emmitt
